_note: Changes observed BETWEEN captures (own words). 'step' = version in which the new state first appears, compared with the previous version. Absence in a capture does NOT prove removal in the framework.

changes.summary: The footer's social network list gains Bluesky in NG19; NG18's lists X, YouTube, Discord, GitHub and Stack Overflow, without Bluesky.

Page 1 of the NG19 PDF contains only the cookie banner and navigation (useless); the Overview body starts on p.2. The textual content of the body is the same as NG18, only re-paragraphed (DevTools sentences are split between pp. 3 and 4).
Footer language list: NG20 has 4 (Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean); Greek (Ελληνικά), present in NG18/NG19, does not appear in NG20.
The last page of NG20 contains only the copyright line and the banner (footer).
In NG20 the sentence about stability and migration tools is split between pp. 3 and 4 because of the PDF pagination.
The opening sentence now says fast and reliable applications 'that users love' (NG18-NG20 say only fast and reliable).
A sentence appears saying that Angular.dev is the official home of the Angular documentation.
The 'Want to see code?' invitation becomes two cards (Essentials: overview of what using Angular is like; Tutorials: step-by-step in the browser); in NG18-NG20 it was a sentence with links.

Features become cards by title (Components, Angular Signals, Server-side rendering, Dependency injection, Angular Routing, Forms in Angular; then CLI, DevTools, ng update, Language Service), with 'Explore ...' links. In NG18-NG20 they were cards with a long call-out headline.

The headline 'opinionated component model and flexible dependency injection system' (NG18-NG20) and the DI sentence 'modular, decoupled and testable' do not appear in NG21; DI becomes the 'Dependency injection' card, described as sharing code across components.

The performance headline of NG18-NG20 ('meet your performance targets with next-generation SSR, SSG, hydration and deferred loading') and the text about @defer blocks do not appear in NG21; the SSR card cites only SSR, SSG and hydration. It does NOT follow that @defer was removed: the capture simply does not cite it.

NG18-NG20 headlines such as 'guarantee everything works together with first-party modules', 'never miss a version with ng update', 'productivity with IDE integration' and the DevTools expression 'browser extension' do not appear in NG21; the router, forms, ng update, DevTools and language service content remains in the new cards.
The 'Languages' footer becomes 'Community translations' with 8 languages (Azərbaycanca, Español, Türkçe, Русский, Korean, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese).
Footer: copyright 2010-2026 and stamp 'Built by Angular at v21.2.20+sha-...' (stamp absent in NG18-NG20).
Spellings: 'esbuild' (lowercase) in the build section link, and 'TensorFlow' (NG18-NG20 write 'ESBuild' in the link and 'Tensorflow').
NG22 is textually identical to NG21 in the body (n-gram comparison); the version label (v22) and the footer stamp (v22.1.2+sha-...) change.
